notes: v1.14.592 - A.2 SHIP 1: THE RACK RECORD ASSEMBLER CORE, WITH A TEMPORARY DEV READOUT. Handoff docs/SHIP-HANDOFF-A2-ASSEMBLER.md, owner GO 2026-09-15; rulings OWNER-RULINGS.md 2026-09-15, Q-1 to Q-9.  WHAT A TECHNICIAN SEES: nothing, unless the page is opened with ?rrdev=1. No nav entry, no dock change, no other surface touched. With ?rrdev=1 a full-screen readout lets you pick a deployment rack and shows its assembled Rack Record (schema rr-1) as JSON with a one-line coverage summary. The readout is temporary and is deleted in A.2 Ship 4.  WHAT IT IS. PHANTOM_RR.assemble(rackId) builds a Rack Record on demand from live storage by folding an ordered adapter registry - identity, then phases - and throws it away: never cached, never persisted, no AI call. It is built beside deploy_generateReport and changes none of it (ruling Q-1). Adapters read through one raw reader that reports absent, unreadable and malformed storage separately and never quarantines or toasts; safeGet is untouched (Q-5). A phase completion needs status complete AND a numeric signedOffAt, because that stamp is never cleared when a phase is reopened. Counts owned by adapters not yet registered (blockers, photos) are null, not 0. No pre-existing line of dct-ios.html is changed.
